fact: AfriLabs lists four Gambian hubs (Disruptive Lab, Gambia Tech, Startup Incubator, Jokkolabs) as open, with blurbs that name no incubation or acceleration programme or cohort.

We are Tech Africa says The Hub, a Banjul technology incubator established in October 2019, offers incubation programs, training, acceleration sessions and mentorship, and has supported over 194 entrepreneurs.

Jokkolabs Banjul, a technology incubation and innovation hub in Bakau, is to host bootcamps, workshops and incubation programmes through an AI Literacy and Skills Academy under a three-year MoU with LingoAI.
